subject: Disconnected from the server [page turn gray when loading data from file]

messages.author: b3d70e1acd70a1b1
messages.subject: Disconnected from the server [page turn gray when loading data from file]
parts:
Hi guys,

I have created a simple Shiny App to generate WordCloud, it works perfectly in local, while deploy to www.shinyapps.io , it does work any more. 
Here is the link to my app https://spark-lin.shinyapps.io/DevDataProduct-FinalProject/
It works well locally, but when run the app online, page turns gray within a minute, and displays "Disconnected from the server".

Before I post this question, I have already try google, did all the possible suggested from www.stackoverflow.com and this Shinyapp.io User group.
Here's posts & solved posts that I found related to my question:
1- https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shinyapps-users/xebU7Py8l-Q
2- https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shinyapps-users/p6g7jRieXd0
3- https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shinyapps-users/IGulSyjlEqM
4- https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shinyapps-users/4zGu2CTAbxc

All the solved answer for this problem is: [Running out of memory, 1G for starter and free user]. 
Suggested solution to this problem is : Change to a larger Instance (upgrade to Paid service to enlarge server memory). 

But I still have some doubts, since the total size of the theShinyApp on my mac is only 3.2 MB !!! I downloaded the Bundle file to my mac, its size is only 1.1 MB.

I also follow the suggested solution mentioned in the above posts links to check the Metrics,  here what is show on my Metrics page:
1- Connection: less than 0.2
2- Memory usage: 25.0 MB
3- Worker Process: around 0.12
4- CPU Usage:  300.0
5- Network usage: just slightly pass 150.0 KB

With the above info, I don't understand why my app will surpass the 1G Memory limitation. I'attach the bundle file with this post, the blow you could find the log info of my ShinyApp. 

If anyone have a hint or any idea of what's going on? Would you please explain a little to me? 

Thank you for your time.

messages.subject: Re: Disconnected from the server [page turn gray when loading data from file]
parts:
The granularity of the memory metric (1 minute) might not be capturing a rapid exhaustion of the 1 GB maximum for large instance types.

The storage size of the code is immaterial, it is the memory consuming while executing the code that is the issue.

When I run your application locally, the rsession consumes 1.5 GB

You might want to investigate tm's memory requirements as it relates to the size of the corpus.

Good luck!
